userStories.title: Phase 0.1: CI/CD Pipeline Setup
userStories.description: [Infrastructure][Foundation] Set up GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with Python testing, linting (ruff), type checking (mypy), and coverage reporting. This establishes the foundation for safe iterative development throughout the modernization.
acceptanceCriteria: PHASE 0 - CREATE_DIR: mkdir -p .github/workflows
PHASE 0 - CREATE_CI: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with Python 3.11 setup, RethinkDB service container, pytest with coverage, ruff linting
PHASE 0 - CI_YAML: Include steps: checkout@v4, setup-python@v5, pip install requirements, pytest --cov=backend --cov-report=xml, ruff check backend/
PHASE 0 - CREATE_DEV_REQS: Create requirements-dev.txt with pytest, pytest-cov, ruff, mypy, black, isort
PHASE 0 - RETHINKDB_SERVICE: Add RethinkDB 2.4 service container on port 28015
TEST - LOCAL_RUN: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && pytest backend/tests/ --cov=backend
TEST - LINT_RUN: ruff check backend/ --fix
TEST - TYPE_CHECK: mypy backend/ --ignore-missing-imports
VALIDATE - PUSH_PR: Create branch phase0/cicd, push changes, open PR to verify CI runs
VALIDATE - ALL_GREEN: CI workflow must show green checkmark on PR
VALIDATE - COVERAGE: Coverage report generated and baseline percentage documented
COMMIT - MSG: git commit -m 'ci: add GitHub Actions workflow with pytest, ruff, and mypy'
DOCUMENT - README: Update README.md with CI badge and local dev instructions

context.rationale: CI/CD is prerequisite for safe iterative development - catches regressions before they reach main

userStories.title: Frontend Phase 0.1: Wire Up WebSocket Progress Hook
userStories.description: [Frontend][Foundation] The useOptimizationProgress.ts hook exists but is NOT used. Wire it up to OptimizationForm.js replacing HTTP polling with WebSocket + polling fallback.

TEST - BUILD: npm run build succeeds without errors

context.rationale: Critical discovery: useOptimizationProgress.ts exists but is NOT USED - this is free value

verifyCommands.test_ws: Open DevTools Network tab, filter by WS, start optimization

breakingRisks.ws_url_mismatch: WebSocket URL format may differ from backend - check REACT_APP_WS_HOST

rollbackProcedure.notes: Polling fallback in hook ensures functionality even if WebSocket fails
